elements.text:
A group of your friends are talking about getting allowance from their parents. Your parents can't afford to give you an allowence, and you have to work a job after school to make money. 

Here are some behaviors that someone might do at that moment or in the future:

texts: I lie and invent an allowance amount so I fit into the conversation.
I steer the conversation toward something everyone can relate to.
I feel the urge to pretend I also get an allowance, but choose to stay quiet instead.
I remind myself later of something I bought or did with money I earned on my own
I want to leave the conversation abruptly, but stay and let it run its course instead.
